test_title: PYST 28: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹3500 as a sum borrowed at 3% per year rate of interest for 6 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹3500

Rate of interest (R) = 3% per year

Time (T) = 6 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

SI = (3500 × 3 × 6) / 100

SI = (35 × 3 × 6)

SI = 35 × 18

⇒ SI = 630

**∴ The simple interest is ₹630.**
